title: The work order lines bulk bar works as before and its X shows Clear selection
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • The app is in the Light theme (avatar at the top right → Light).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer, with two lines, {Line-1} and {Line-2} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL bulkbar line 1" and "ZZAUTOTEST PL bulkbar line 2").
  • You know how the work order lines bulk bar looked and behaved on the build before this one (for example from a screenshot of it).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  2. Open {Work-order-1} on its Lines tab.
  3. Click the checkbox of {Line-1}.
  4. Click the checkbox of {Line-2}.
  5. Look at the bar that appears: its count, its buttons and its X.
  6. Hover over the X at the right end of the bar.
  7. Click the avatar at the top right and pick Dark.
  8. Look at the bar.
  9. Click the avatar at the top right and pick Light.
  10. Click the X.
  11. Click the checkbox of {Line-1}.
  12. Click one of the bar's action buttons and complete it as you would on the earlier build.
  13. Click Undo if the bar or a toast offers it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The bulk bar shows a round count badge "2" and the word "selected", its action buttons and an X at the right end, the same as on the earlier build.
  • Step 6: Hovering the X shows "Clear selection" (this hover text is new on this build).
  • Step 8: In the dark theme the bar looks as it did on the earlier build in the dark theme.
  • Step 10: The bar disappears and both lines are unticked.
  • Step 12: The button does to the ticked line exactly what it did on the earlier build.
  • Step 13: Undo, where offered, works as it did on the earlier build. Any difference from the earlier build other than the new "Clear selection" hover text fails the case: describe it in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S2-R9, §5 Terminology, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.2 (Mode on), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026), Phase 1 verification (browser-walk). Story SV-11038 (Verify Phase 1) checklist. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • PRD §5 Terminology (Bulk bar): “Bulk bar → The dark bar across the Inventory list, under the Active and Inactive tabs, while bulk status mode is on. It is the same bar work order lines show for ticked lines.”
  • S2-R9: “An X button sits at the right end of the bar. Hovering it shows "Clear selection", which is also its screen reader label.”
  • Tech plan Phase 1 (Verification: Browser-walk): “a work order with ticked lines, light and dark theme. The bulk bar must look and behave exactly as before, except that hovering the X now shows "Clear selection".”
  • SV-11038 verification checklist (Verify Phase 1): “Work order lines bulk mode still works exactly as before on the extracted bulk bar shell; its X now shows a "Clear selection" tooltip (S2-R9)”
